description: One website on sale by its id (3f9a1c07b2e85d64): its SEO score, the share of Triremes' checks of what search engines can read on its homepage that it fails, weighted by how serious each check is (0% means no gaps; higher is worse), with its label (No gaps, Lightly flawed, Flawed, Badly flawed or Catastrophic), the checks it failed by name, when it was measured, its price, how many times it has been sold and the time of each sale, and its page. A website with no SEO score yet is being measured: being_measured is true, it has no price and it can be bought once it has an SEO score.
